name: Belair

meta.title: Cleaning services in Belair
meta.description: Discreet home cleaning and private housekeeping for houses and apartments in Belair, Luxembourg City.

intro: Belair's family homes and elegant apartments call for a discreet, consistent service. We provide it, with the same people every visit.
paragraphs: Close to the city centre and the Parc de Merl, Belair is one of the capital's most sought-after residential quarters. Many of its homes are spacious, with fine materials and furnishings that need knowledgeable care.

Our clients here often combine regular cleaning with housekeeping, ironing and seasonal window cleaning. Every household has a written checklist and a dedicated cleaner or housekeeper, backed by a supervisor.
